title: Quantum-Limited Blind Source Separation of Classical Light
summary: Using the framework of quantum multiparameter estimation, we study the problem of separating independent thermal optical sources mixed by an unknown passive linear transformation, which is known as blind source separation in signal processing. We propose a sensing-assisted method that iteratively estimates and suppresses optical correlations directly within the unit cells of a programmable interferometer.
